v611_defects_measured.why_relocate: with the tower top screws at r 19 / 0-125-240 deg, no box-screw triangle reachable from below surrounds the axis: inside the box only the servo|board corridor and the -Y bay are free; outside, the -X side is blocked by the chute and the 125/240 access bores; the v6.1 factory order (tower onto box, then onto bowl) is impossible because the box roof covers the tower-top screws

changes.8_firmware_note: At power-on the disc must NOT dispense: both rest positions (0 and 180 deg) are closed (rotary airlock). The firmware must store the last commanded rest position in non-volatile memory (NVS / flash, written only when it changes) and command exactly that position at boot, with the servo PWM enabled only after the stored value has been loaded; a cold start without a stored value goes to 0 deg. This complements the existing contract (boots OFF, one cycle on a commanded ON, one per press).
